verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for an observability platform that stores telemetry. However, no evidence item mentions choosing a storage region, deployment location, or residency controls. Items about running Elastic Agent in containers and ingesting to a single endpoint concern data collection, not where data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
